name: Cloforex

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Germany and Sweden, first in 1969 — for breathing problems and heart harm

similar.name: Clofibrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Israel and 2 other countries, first in 1979 — for blood vessel problems and cancer risk

similar.name: Beclobrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Switzerland, first in 1990 — for liver harm

similar.name: Chlorphentermine
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Venezuela, first in 1967 — for breathing problems and heart harm

summary: Cloforex was removed from the market in Germany and Sweden starting in 1969 due to breathing issues and heart damage [3]. A small computer test, rather than research in humans, gave the drug low scores for heart and liver risks [M]. Related medicines have also been withdrawn from several countries because of concerns including liver harm, blood vessel issues, cancer risk, and heart and breathing troubles [3].
